name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a priest, you may see Faladiel's fall from grace in his turn from calling the flame to betraying and murdering members of his own order.
As a shaman attuned to fire and elemental rites, you may recognize the primal nature of feeding a traitor's essence to the flames to intensify their sacred power.

faq.answer: Skypriest Faladiel was once a devoted caller of the flame and a member of the Windshapers. He joined the Al'Aketh for power, betraying his former brothers and sisters and staining his hands with their blood.

aliases: why do windshapers want faladiel dead
faq.answer: Faladiel betrayed the Windshapers for power and murdered his former brothers and sisters. Their creed calls for blood to answer for blood, so they seek his execution as retribution.
faq.q: Why do the Windshapers want Faladiel killed?

faq.answer: The Windshapers need Faladiel's heart for a ritual. They believe a traitor's heart will make their flames burn hotter and with greater intensity.
faq.q: Why do the Windshapers need Faladiel's heart?

faq.answer: Skypriest Faladiel hides at a farm in the Gustberry Lowlands, northeast past Valanaar and just south of the Shrine of Akir.
faq.q: Where can Skypriest Faladiel be found?

faq.answer: The Windshapers' creed holds that blood must be repaid in blood. They practice flame-calling and sacred elemental rituals.
faq.q: What is the creed of the Windshapers?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh include members who traded former allegiances and honor for personal power. Skypriest Faladiel is one such member.
faq.q: What is the Al'Aketh's connection to this mission?

sections.body: The Windshapers send you after Skypriest Faladiel, once one of their own. He left the order to join the Al'Aketh and traded his calling as a flame-caller for power. He betrayed his former brothers and sisters, and their blood stains his hands. Now the Windshapers send you to carry out their judgment.
sections.title: A Traitor Among the Flame

sections.body: Faladiel hides at a farm in the Gustberry Lowlands, northeast past Valanaar and just south of the Shrine of Akir. The Windshapers seek more than vengeance. They need his heart for an upcoming ritual. They believe a betrayer's heart will lend their sacred flames unmatched intensity.
sections.title: Reckoning in the Lowlands

sections.body: The Windshapers hold to their creed: blood must answer for blood. Faladiel's heart is only one part of what must feed their ceremonial fire before their rites can be concluded.
sections.title: Blood Paid with Blood

summary: The Windshapers send you after a traitor who chose power over his order. Skypriest Faladiel has fled to the Gustberry Lowlands, and they need his heart for a ritual.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
